parameters.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT
    itsm.set_rls_context(NULLIF('{{ $json.realm }}','')) AS realm_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{ $json.occurred_at }}',''), 'undefined')::timestamptz, NOW()) AS occurred_at,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ JSON.stringify($json.actor || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'undefined')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS actor,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ String($json.actor_type ?? "unknown").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'undefined'), 'unknown') AS actor_type,
    '{{ String($json.action || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS action,
    '{{ String($json.source || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS source,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.resource_type || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}','') AS resource_type,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.correlation_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}','') AS correlation_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ JSON.stringify($json.reply_target || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'undefined')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS reply_target,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.summary || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}','') AS summary,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}','') AS message,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ JSON.stringify($json.after || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'undefined')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS after,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ JSON.stringify($json.integrity || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'undefined')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS integrity
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO itsm.audit_event (
    realm_id, occurred_at, actor, actor_type, action, source,
    resource_type, correlation_id, reply_target, summary, message, after, integrity
  )
  SELECT
    v.realm_id, v.occurred_at, v.actor, v.actor_type, v.action, v.source,
    v.resource_type, v.correlation_id, v.reply_target, v.summary, v.message, v.after, v.integrity
  FROM v
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM ins), NULL) AS audit_event_id,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins) AS inserted;

'true' : '', audit_event_id: ins.audit_event_id ?? null }; if (!inserted) { out.skipped = true; out.reason = 'duplicate_notification'; } return [{ json: out }];
